read_scope.abilities: 程序提取十二英雄64块（含四调用技能）；实际解释四候选、四主干与DK/Io/SD替代/伙伴所需字段/说明。TA只作资源核对，不新增TA结论；程序抽取不当全块运行审读。
read_scope.items: 18物品条目提取成本/恢复、位移与施距字段；实际推导使用文中明确项，魂戒/吹风仅作相邻投入核对，不称全物品交互验证。

read_scope.localization: 四候选与四主干、Io/SD伙伴所需指定说明，含EMP按实际烧英雄法力回50%；本轮读取范围不包含所有隐含物品/引擎行为。
read_scope.official: 7.28实际页面仅VS重做与魔晶起购时间，7.30/7.33各四英雄指定条目；7.31的Pugna条目复用前一来源，不重报本轮HTTP。

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_dual_breath_: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_ice_path_Des: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_ice_path_Not: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_liquid_fire_: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks.
Works on both units and buildings.
Shard: Does NOT grants Liquid Frost ability.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_liquid_ice_D: Stuns enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and applies a frost debuff that slows enemy movement speed by %movement_slow%%% and take %base_damage% plus %pct_health_damage%%% of their max health per second as damage for %duration% seconds.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_macropyre_De: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_macropyre_sc: Increases Macropyre distance by +400 range, duration by +20 seconds and causes it to become Pure damage and pierce Spell Immunity.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_jakiro_macropyre_No: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_nether_blast_: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals half damage to structures.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_decrepify_Des: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Afflicted units take extra magic damage.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_decrepify_Not: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_nether_ward_D: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero. Nether Ward heals 25% of its total health every time it triggers.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_nether_ward_N: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_life_drain_De: CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target. If Pugna has full HP, and the enemy target is a Hero, Life Drain will restore mana instead.\n\nWhen cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_life_drain_sh: For every 1.5 seconds of channel, another secondary Life Drain is created targeting another random enemy hero.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_life_drain_No: Health gained depends on the actual damage dealt.
Illusions are destroyed on the first tick of damage.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_vengefulspirit_magi: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_vengefulspirit_wave: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the armor of enemies and giving vision of the path ahead.
Wave of Terror steals 20%% of enemy hero base damage and base armor, granting it to Vengeful Spirit for the debuff duration.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_vengefulspirit_comm: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes.

Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals and takes 100%% damage and can cast all of her spells. Illusion has 12%% movement speed bonus. If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her.
Vengeance Illusion keeps providing the Vengeance Aura after Vengeful Spirit's death.
Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_vengefulspirit_neth: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy.  Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take %damage% damage Allied swapped units receive less damage for a short duration
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_D: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.\n\nThe extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_N: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_mystic_snake: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake deals more damage per jump and returns %snake_mana_steal%%% mana based on the targets' total mana.
Causes Mystic Snake to turn enemies hit into stone. Stone duration increases with each bounce of the Mystic Snake.

Stone Gaze must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.
Shard: Does NOT grant Cold Blooded ability.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_mana_shield_: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Provides bonus mana capacity.
Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_cold_blooded: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy. Cooldown: 12.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_stone_gaze_D: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical damage.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_stone_gaze_N: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_breat: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_drago: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit in melee range with his shield, stunning it while dealing minor damage.  When in Elder Dragon Form, the cast range increases to %dragon_cast_range%.
The life blood of the Dragon improves health regeneration and strengthens armor.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_fireb: Ignites a %radius% AoE area for %duration% seconds, dealing %damage% damage per second that lingers for %linger_duration% seconds to enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_elder:
Dragon Knight takes the form of one of three powerful elder dragons, increasing his speed, and Dragon Tail's range, while granting him new powers.
<font color="#9acd32">LEVEL 1 Green Dragon</font> - Corrosive Breath: attacks deal %corrosive_breath_damage% poison damage per second for %corrosive_breath_duration% seconds. Works on structures.
<font color="#ff0000">LEVEL 2 Red Dragon</font> - Splash Attack: attacks damage all enemy units in a %splash_radius% radius for %splash_damage_percent%%% damage, with Corrosive Breath added to the targets.
<font color="#87ceeb">LEVEL 3 Blue Dragon</font> - Frost Breath: slows movement speed by %frost_bonus_movement_speed%%% and attack speed by %frost_bonus_attack_speed% of enemy units in Splash Attack range for %frost_duration% seconds, with Corrosive Breath added to the targets.
Grants Elder Dragon Form the Fireball ability.

Increases the level of Dragon Knight's ultimate. Adds a 4th level, Black Dragon. Black Dragon has bonus Corrosive Damage, Splash Damage and Slow amount, 20% increased Magic Resistance and free pathing.
Corrosive Breath poison damage is lethal.
Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Dragon Knight was in when the item was used.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_leshrac_split_earth: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.

Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location three additional times, with a 5 second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by 75. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_leshrac_diabolic_ed: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and structures.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
Can damage buildings, Spell Immune units, and invisible units.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_leshrac_lightning_s: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies are slowed.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_leshrac_greater_lig: Causes all nearby enemies in %radius% AoE to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, causing them to take %magic_amp%%% more magic damage and be slowed by %slow%%% for %duration% seconds. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause you to take amplified damage.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_leshrac_pulse_nova_: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_D: Puck launches a magic orb that floats in a straight path, damaging enemy units along the way. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_a: For Ability Draft only, Illusory Orb ability swaps with Ethereal Jaunt while the orb is in flight.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_N: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_waning_rift_De: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_waning_rift_sh: Waning Rift now deals 70 bonus damage and knocks enemies back 250 distance over 0.4 seconds (non-interrupting). Reveals invisible enemy units and wards in the area for 5 seconds.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_De: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_No: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_ethereal_jaunt: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_dream_coil_Des: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_dream_coil_sce: Increases damage from coil breaks, increases coil duration, coil break stun goes through spell immunity.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_plasma_field_: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_static_link_D: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows razor to attack while moving with the link active.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_static_link_N: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_unstable_curr: Causes Storm Surge to have an 18% chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release forked lightning that strikes the target and up to 2 other enemies. Deals 150 Damage and slows them by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_eye_of_the_st: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at enemy units with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing their armor.
Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_quas_Descri: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Each <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> instance provides increased health regeneration.\n
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_quas_shard_: Quas provides +10% Spell Lifesteal per instance.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_quas_Note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_wex_Descrip: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Each <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instance provides increased attack speed and movement speed.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_wex_shard_d: Wex provides +100 Cast Range per instance.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_wex_Note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_exort_Descr: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Each <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instance provides increased attack damage.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_exort_shard: Exort provides +5% Spell Amplification per instance.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_exort_Note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_empty1_Desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_empty2_Desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_invoke_Desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.

Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_invoke_Note: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_emp_Descrip: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_emp_Note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_emp_ad_Desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_emp_ad_Note: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_tornado_Des: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_tornado_Not: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_tornado_ad_: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_cold_snap_D: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_cold_snap_N: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_cold_snap_a: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.
The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_invoker_ghost_walk_: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_Descrip: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, tethered units target gains a larger portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_shard_d: Tether stuns enemies touching it for 1.75 seconds and deals 150 damage. Does not affect the same unit more than once every 7 seconds. Increases movement speed bonus by 8%%.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_Note0: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, he will latch on and pull himself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_Note1: The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_Note2: Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_tether_break_D: Break the link to the tethered unit.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_Descri: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_Note0: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_scepte: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second. Max of 5.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_in_Des: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_out_De: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_overcharge_Des: Io gains bonus attack speed, spell amplification, and HP Regen based on max health.  If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains the bonuses.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_in_Des: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_spirits_out_De: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Descr: Teleports Io and any tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires Io and any tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note0: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note1: If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note2: If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleported along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_demon_disrup: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit are created under Shadow Demon's control.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_demon_soul_c: Captures the soul of enemy units in an area, causing them to lose a percentage of their current health. Shadow Demon temporarily gains Spell Amplification for each hero's soul captured. When the debuff is removed, the units gain half of the lost health back. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Soul Catcher.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_demon_shadow: In Ability Draft, Shadow Poison Release works by toggling auto-cast off, either by right-clicking the ability, or using the alt-hotkey combo.  Auto-cast state will be on if there are any units with Shadow Poison applied.

Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.
Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.
Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

description_text.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_demon_demoni: Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

Cooldown is removed, replaced with %max_charges% charges that replenish every %charge_restore_time_tooltip_scepter% seconds. Also causes Demonic Purge to break its target's passive abilities while active.
Allows Demonic Purge to be cast on allies, continuously dispelling them and healing for its damage values. Does not slow allies.
The slow starts at %max_slow%%% decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.

ability_notes.note: Now deals 50 damage to enemies
Nether Swap now causes Vengeful Spirits and allies she Swaps to take 30/40/50% less damage for 3 seconds

talent_notes.note: Level 15 talent improved from -0.8s Nether Blast Cooldown to -1s

ability_notes.note: No longer has a mana reducing aura
Now additionally Heals 2 hits whenever it triggers
Cast Point improved from 0.55 to 0.35
Burn damage increased from 12/16/20/24 to 15/20/25/30
